title: Moana 2 — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Reproduction explains more of Moana 2 than any philosophy dares to admit. Moana 2 is a 2024 American animated musical adventure film directed by David Derrick Jr., Jason Hand, and Dana Ledoux Miller and written by Miller and Jared Bush. Produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios, it is the second animated film in the Moana franchise, following the 2016 film.

Moana 2 did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Four special dubbings in Polynesian languages were released for the sequel, in Hawaiian, Māori, Tahitian, and Samoan. The first three languages had previously received a dubbing of the first film, while a Samoan dubbing of the sequel was released without the original film having been dubbed.
